scope: Selection after development, before opening the reserved final datasets
quality_panel: Original HEAD vs P3h on 13 available development datasets x seeds 42,53, equal 120-second caps

quality_preference.aggregation: Per-seed results and per-dataset means both retained; positive utility-oriented relative gain; never mean raw heterogeneous scores

reliability: No added unexplained dummy-only, invalid CSV, crash, OOM or timeout failures on available paired cases. Functional gates must match selected runtime SHA. Source availability failures do not become zero quality scores.
efficiency: Retain full refit and inspect checkpoint latency / wall / CPU / RSS; report trade-offs instead of interpreting a longer budget as a quality gain.
component_policy: Keep optional specialists only with measured subset utility and task-local validation. Do not force target encoding or fold averaging by default.
final_policy: Freeze archive hashes and all ten cases before data download. Report all frozen final scores, including regressions; no algorithm adjustment after opening. >=8 successfully paired distinct datasets desired; unsupported original-baseline metrics are separate unpaired capability checks.
fallback: If P3h fails promotion, preserve it as a research version; choose the last verified Pareto candidate using development observations, and run the required exact-source gates before final opening.

revisions.change: Candidate P3g -> P3h before broad comparison starts; thresholds unchanged
revisions.reason: Measured word+char improvement on both SMS seeds was not guaranteed an initial probe when a non-linear candidate led. Add a text-classification-only early sparse probe; one targeted regression test passed.
